text: Code reviews are an essential practice for any development team. When a developer writes code, another team member carefully examines it before it is merged into the main project. This process is highly effective for catching bugs early, before they reach the final product and become much more expensive to fix. Beyond finding errors, code reviews are a fantastic tool for knowledge sharing. Team members learn new techniques and understand different parts of the codebase they might not normally work on. This shared understanding builds a stronger, more collaborative team, ensuring that the quality of the code and the expertise of the developers both improve over time.
